avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces talazoparib exposure and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncologist before use

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract/Seed
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and BCRP inhibitor increases talazoparib levels and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; allow 3-day washout before starting talazoparib

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce talazoparib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or monitor for reduced efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition; minimal clinical impact expected
caution_supplements.action: Use with monitoring; report any increased side effects

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard culinary amounts; monitor for enhanced effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Pomelo
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and BCRP inhibition increases talazoparib concentration and toxicity

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase talazoparib absorption; variable effect on PK
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent food pattern; maintain same timing relative to meals

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (high quantities)
caution_foods.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 induction with chronic high intake
caution_foods.action: Consume in normal dietary amounts; no restriction needed

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hematologic toxicity and GI tolerability as talazoparib has a narrow therapeutic window. Regular CBC monitoring is essential; adjust dosing if severe myelosuppression occurs. Patients should maintain consistent meal timing and composition to minimize pharmacokinetic variability.
